hypothesis.signal: VRP(t) = EVZ_asof(t) - RV21(t), both annualized vol points
hypothesis.rv_def: RV21 = 100*sqrt(252*mean(r^2)) over last 21 valid daily log returns incl. day t; no demeaning; oldest return within 45 cal days else void
hypothesis.pair: EUR_USD only (EVZ is EUR-complex IV; no cross-pair extension in this family)
hypothesis.horizon: +21 valid D1 positions (close-to-close, NY17 boundary); span>45 cal days void
hypothesis.direction: TWO-SIDED registration (G10 single-pair sign prior uncertain); OOS one-sided at explore-observed sign g (holiday leg-a / cot #16 precedent)
hypothesis.sampling: every valid FX D1 day (daily, overlapping fwd windows)

iv.alignment: same-day join FX-D1 label T <-> EVZ obs date T; EVZ 16:15 ET precedes FX close 17:00 ET (no lookahead); same-day 97.1%, asof staleness max 3 cal days; >3d void

gates.A_headroom_pass1: unconditional median |fwd21 move| >= 10x stressed_RT = 40.0p else KILL
gates.B_power_pass1: N>=1500 valid days AND floor(N/21)>=70 else UNDERPOWERED
gates.C_primary: pooled Spearman IC(VRP, fwd21) two-sided p<0.05 (m=1), null = circular-shift permutation (k~U{42..N-42}, B=10000, seed 20260817, p=(1+#{|ICperm|>=|ICobs|})/(1+B))
gates.D_stressed_net: extreme-tercile (window-local) per-obs net = g_terc*move + swap(side) - stressed_RT; pooled mean > 0 at adverse end (RT 4.0p, markup 1.65%/yr); point (2.0p, 1.0%/yr) sensitivity non-binding
gates.E_concentration: max_y |S_y| / sum_y |S_y| <= 0.50, S_y = yearly signed gross sum of extreme-tercile obs
gates.F_consistency: annual IC sign >= 6/8 in pooled direction AND LOYO 8/8 sign-stable; false-kill risk pre-recorded; C-PASS/F-FAIL = regime-inconsistent FAIL close, no relitigation
gates.G_monotonicity: tercile means monotonic in g (adjacent violations <=1) AND T3-T1 spread sign = g
knife_edge_post_pass_only: pip simple-diff fwd instead of log
gates.oos_gates: one-sided circular-shift p<0.05 at g (seed 20260819) AND OOS gate D adverse >0 AND N>=600 & floor(N/21)>=28 (else OOS UNDERPOWERED = decision point NOT reached) AND OOS extreme-tercile gross mean >= +5.0p economic floor
gates.bh_merge_clause: if another explore family launches before verdict -> BH q=0.10 denominator merge (cc-mr sec5 compensation c)
gates.claim_scope: family-pooled EUR_USD only; per-slice claims permanently banned

honest_power.framing: cheap honestly-gated kill attempt; gate B defined on N floors only, no post-hoc power excuses

friction.stressed_rationale: NY17-close measurement convention adjacent to rollover dead zone; qs #17 measured abnormal RT = 2-3x normal
friction.swap_formula: swap_pips = (rate_used/100)*(H_cal/365)*S_entry/1e-4; rate_used = side*d_EUR_USD(t) - m; m_adverse=1.65 binding, m_point=1.0 sensitivity
friction.magnitude_prerecord: 2018-19 d~-2.9%/yr -> long-EUR adverse cost ~40p/obs at 21bd; swap can dominate friction (multi-week net-of-swap hard rule)
